data.one_liner: Flutter Client SDK for LiveKit to build real-time video, audio, and data features.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to connect to LiveKit servers for real-time multi-user video conferencing, live streaming, and voice communication. It supports iOS, Android, Web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
use_when: You need to build video calls or live streaming into your Flutter app.
You are using LiveKit Cloud or a self-hosted LiveKit server.
You require real-time audio and video support across mobile, web, and desktop.
avoid_when: You only need basic recorded video playback without real-time streaming or conferencing.
You are targeting platforms that do not support WebRTC.
strengths: Cross-platform support across mobile, web, and desktop.
Built-in adaptive streaming and dynacast support.
Comprehensive network options including certificate pinning.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration and permissions for camera, microphone, and bluetooth.
Web platform has limitations regarding certificate pinning.
data.setup_notes: Requires camera and microphone permission declarations in Info.plist for iOS and AndroidManifest.xml for Android, plus platform-specific Podfile adjustments and permission_handler setup for Bluetooth.
